author: mmarriot
body:
#### PR description:

This adds `ClusterHitsTableProducer` to PhysicsTools/NanoAOD. It writes the hits of each calorimeter cluster, from `hitsAndFractions()`. It is a template on the cluster type, registered as three modules: `CaloClusterHitsTableProducer` (`reco::CaloCluster`, e.g. HGCal layer clusters), `PFClusterHitsTableProducer` (`reco::PFCluster`) and `SuperClusterHitsTableProducer` (`reco::SuperCluster`).

Configured with the same `src`, `cut` and `maxLen` as an existing cluster table, it writes:

- `n<hitsName>`: the number of hits of each cluster, added as a column to the cluster table;
- a `<hitsName>` table with one row per hit, in cluster order: the raw `detId` and the energy `fraction`.

The DetIds join with the existing rechit tables (PhysicsTools/TruthInfo, DPGAnalysis/HcalNanoAOD), so hit-level truth matching, ML training and clustering validation can run on NanoAOD instead of RECO. A SuperCluster can list a hit more than once; its fraction is then the sum of its rows.

This is a separate module because the `collectionVariables` of `SimpleCollectionFlatTableProducer` cannot read a `vector<pair<DetId, float>>`.

No existing workflow uses the new modules, so no changes are expected.

#### PR validation:

- New unit tests in `testPhysicsToolsNanoAODTP` cover the three modules, `cut` and `maxLen`, repeated hits, `precision`, empty and missing input, the 65535-hit limit of the count, and a `hitsName` equal to `name`.
- On Phase-2 ttbar RECO (20 events) and Run 3 data RECO (50 events), the tables match a FWLite read of `hitsAndFractions()` for every cluster collection tested, covering all three modules: `reco::CaloCluster` (HGCal layer clusters with and without a cut, e/gamma basic clusters, ES clusters), `reco::PFCluster` (ECAL, PS, HCAL, HF, HO) and `reco::SuperCluster` (HGCal, e/gamma, EB, EE).
- Timing on Phase-2 ttbar at 200 pileup, 1 thread: 4 ms/event for the HGCal layer clusters (395k hits), under 0.05 ms/event for each of the other collections.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Not a backport.
title: Add NanoAOD tables of the hits of calorimeter clusters
